title: 11 · race · The Race Around the World
lines: Two brothers raced around the world.
One of them never left the room.
Narada arrived with a single golden fruit.
The fruit of all knowledge. It cannot be shared.
"The fruit of all knowledge. It cannot be shared."
Three times around the world. The first one back takes it.
"Three times around the world. The first one back takes it."
Kartikeya was gone before the sentence ended.
On a peacock, at the speed of thought.
and walked around his mother and father. Three times.
You are my whole world, he said.
"You are my whole world," he said.
His brother was already eating the fruit.
One of them saw the whole world.
One of them knew what the world was.
Know what your world is. That is sadhana.
